en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet cobblestoned town square in a European town. On the left is a row of narrow gabled houses and a prominent building with an ornate tower and spire topped by a weather vane, likely the town hall. In the foreground a man stands by a horse cart and a small handcart. Across the square stands a large inn or hotel with several dormer windows and a sign on the facade. More small houses close the perspective toward the back of the square.
